peercraft.modsync.notice.title: PeerCraft — Mod sync & trust
peercraft.modsync.notice.body1: Mod sync will download and install the host's mods into your mods folder.
peercraft.modsync.notice.body2: A mod is a program. Mods from a malicious host can run any code on your computer.
peercraft.modsync.notice.body3: Only continue if you trust this host as much as a mod you downloaded yourself.
peercraft.modsync.confirm.trust_reminder: Only sync with a host you trust — mods are executable code.

peercraft.gui.settings.title: PeerCraft — Settings
peercraft.gui.settings.forced_by_flag: Set by a launch flag — the flag wins this session
peercraft.gui.settings.invalid_number: "%s" needs a whole number in range
peercraft.gui.settings.developer_warning: Change only if you know what you're doing — these can disable the mod or break connections.
peercraft.gui.settings.autoaccept_warnin: Disables the download confirmation — the host's jars install with no prompt.
peercraft.gui.settings.mode_desc: Auto: role decided by what you click. Client/Host: pin a role. Disabled: turn PeerCraft off.
peercraft.gui.settings.modsync_client_de: What you download when joining someone else's world: Disabled, Required mods only, or All mods.
peercraft.gui.settings.modsync_host_desc: What you share with players joining your world: Disabled, Required mods only, or All mods.
peercraft.gui.settings.reoffer_declined_: Show the download prompt on every join, even for mods you unchecked before.
peercraft.gui.settings.max_total_mb_desc: Reject a mod-sync batch whose jars total more than this (1-4096).
peercraft.gui.settings.max_mod_mb_desc: Reject or abort any single jar larger than this (1-2048).
peercraft.gui.settings.internet_play: Play over the internet by default
peercraft.gui.settings.internet_play_des: Pre-ticks the "play over the internet" checkbox on the Open to LAN screen.
peercraft.gui.settings.handoff_desc: Show "Hand off hosting" on the pause screen, and accept handoff offers from a host.
peercraft.gui.settings.handoff_decline_s: Hosts can't pick you on the hand-off screen, and you won't receive offers.
peercraft.gui.settings.handoff_confirm_b: Ask "Hand off hosting to <player>?" before sending the offer — a handoff can't be cleanly undone once accepted.
peercraft.gui.settings.handoff_chat_noti: Post a chat line when an offer arrives, and when it's accepted/declined/finished.
peercraft.gui.settings.max_players_desc: Default player count for a room opened over the internet (1-8). Sets the starting value of the toggle on the Open to LAN screen.
peercraft.gui.settings.max_players_desc_: Default player count for a room opened over the internet (%s–%s). Sets the starting value of the toggle on the Open to LAN screen.
peercraft.gui.settings.rendezvous_host_d: Address of the matchmaking / account server.
peercraft.gui.settings.rendezvous_port_d: UDP port of the matchmaking server (0-65535).
peercraft.gui.settings.proxy_port_desc: Local TCP port the joining Minecraft client connects to (0-65535).
peercraft.gui.settings.client_udp_port_d: UDP port the joining side of the bridge listens on (0-65535).
peercraft.gui.settings.host_udp_port_des: UDP port the host side listens on after Open to LAN (0-65535).
peercraft.gui.settings.peer_host_desc: Remote peer address for the static (non-internet) local-test path.
peercraft.gui.settings.peer_port_desc: Remote peer UDP port on the static local-test path (0-65535). Blank = derive it.
peercraft.handoff.picker.title: Hand off hosting to another player
peercraft.handoff.picker.intro: The chosen player receives a copy of the world and becomes the new host. Everyone reconnects to them; you can then leave.
peercraft.handoff.picker.no_candidates: No connected players can take over right now.
peercraft.handoff.picker.row_not_signed_: %s — not signed in to a PeerCraft account
peercraft.handoff.picker.row_declined_su: %s — chose not to be a successor
peercraft.handoff.picker.confirm.title: Hand off hosting?
peercraft.handoff.picker.confirm.body: The world will be copied to %s and they become the new host. This can't be cleanly undone once they accept.
peercraft.handoff.picker.friends_only_no: This is a friends-only room — after the handoff, who may join is decided by the new host's friends list.
peercraft.handoff.status.transferring: Sending the world to the new host…
peercraft.handoff.status.ok_timeout: New host did not confirm in time — proceeding anyway.
peercraft.handoff.status.done: Handoff complete — you can leave now.
peercraft.handoff.offer.title: %s wants to hand you the world
peercraft.handoff.offer.body: You would receive a copy of "%s" (about %s) and become the new host. Everyone reconnects to you.
peercraft.handoff.receiving.title: Receiving the world from the new host
peercraft.handoff.migrating.title: The host is migrating
peercraft.handoff.migrating.body: The world is moving to a new host. Reconnecting automatically…
peercraft.handoff.migrating.waiting_for_: Waiting for the new host to come online…
peercraft.handoff.reclaim.title: This world is coming back to you
peercraft.handoff.reclaim.body: You already have a copy of "%s". "Update with backup" will keep it as "%s". "Overwrite" deletes it with no way to recover it.
peercraft.handoff.reclaim.overwrite_conf: Your current copy of "%s" will be deleted with no way to recover it.
peercraft.handoff.stale.title: This world was handed off
peercraft.handoff.stale.body: You handed this world to %s on %s. Changes made since then are on their copy, not this one — opening this copy starts from the older state.
peercraft.handoff.decline.missing_mods: You are missing mods this world requires.
peercraft.handoff.decline.not_signed_in: You must be signed in to a PeerCraft account to become a host.
peercraft.handoff.decline.declined: The player declined to take over.
peercraft.handoff.decline.unknown: The player could not take over.
peercraft.handoff.abort.no_response: The chosen player did not respond.
peercraft.handoff.abort.transfer_failed: Sending the world to the new host failed.
peercraft.handoff.abort.picked_someone_e: The host chose a different player.
peercraft.handoff.chat.offer_received: You've been offered this world's hosting — see the screen that just opened.
peercraft.handoff.chat.done: Handoff to %s complete — you can leave now.
